Asset.description:
One picture of a Doc, without its bytes: the shape a machine Doc's
state gives (`DocState.assets`).

rev.description:
Changes whenever the name is written with other bytes: clients cache
a picture by `name/rev`.

ChatAgent.description:
The agent that wrote a message (M197): the machine whose grant it acted
through, and its name now. The message's author is the machine's owner.

session.description:
The session that posted, as its machine called it then (#429): an
agent block's title, or the Claude Code session's name. Display
only; never what a permission rests on.

Doc.description: A Doc, without its sections: a list's row, and a view's head.

agent.description:
The agent session that made it as itself (aru-115): its `machine`
the session's id (`ses_…`), its name `Agent session <id>`.

author.description:
The account that made it, or "" once it's deleted, or for one an
agent session made.

machine.description:
The machine this Doc is a copy from, or null for one made here. A
copy is read-only here: the machine's Doc is the truth (#678).

machine_name.description:
That machine's name, when control knows it: null for a Doc made
here, or once the machine left. Older pages don't read it.

made_from.description:
For a team Doc made from a Doc of its owner's (Share with…): where
from. Null for any other Doc, and from an older platform.

sections.description: How many sections it has, and how many are written.

DocCopies.description:
`GET` [`PROJECT_DOC_COPIES`]: the team Docs made from a Doc, earliest
first, in the projects its owner still reads.

DocCopy.description: A team Doc made from a Doc of its owner's, as its owner sees it.

edited.description: The team changed it since: its rev is above the one recorded.

id.description: The team Doc's id, and its page on the platform's page.

made.description: When it was made, and when it last changed (ms since the epoch).

stale.description: The source changed since: its rev is above the one recorded.

DocList.description: `GET` [`PROJECT_DOCS`]: a project's Docs, the latest changed first.

writer.description: Whether the reader may make one.

DocView.description: `GET` [`PROJECT_DOC`]: a Doc with its sections, in order.

deleter.description:
Whether the reader may delete it: a person who writes in the
project, a copy included (native #673). An older platform sends
none; the page then takes `writer`.

writer.description: Whether the reader may write it.

DocWrite.description:
`PUT` [`PROJECT_DOC`]: what changes. `title` renames it. With `section`,
that section's body becomes `markdown` (and its heading `heading`, when
given); with no `section` but a `heading`, a section is added at the
end, written when `markdown` is given and pending otherwise.

Edited.description: The 409 to an [`UpdateCopy`] that would replace the team's edits.

MachineDoc.description:
`PUT` [`MACHINE_DOC`]: the whole Doc as the machine has it now. The
sections replace the copy's; the same content again changes nothing.

MachineDocPlaced.description: Where a machine's copy is, answering `PUT` [`MACHINE_DOC`].

link.description: The Doc's page on the platform's page.

rev.description: Counts the copy's changes; the same content again leaves it.

MachineSection.description:
A section of a machine's Doc, as it copies it up: the machine's own
ids, and its body or null while it's pending.

MadeFrom.description: The Doc a team Doc was made from: a machine's copy, or one written here.

machine_name.description:
The name of the machine the source is a copy from, when control knows
it; null for a source written here. Only what the platform could
tell; the source itself is its owner's to read.

project.description: The source Doc's project (its owner's personal one) and its id.

NewSection.description:
A new Doc's section: a heading, and its Markdown now or an intent for
later.

Section.description: One section: pending (`body` null) until it's written.

body.description: Its Markdown (the machine Doc's: `chart` and `svg` fences draw).

id.description: The Doc's own: `s1`, `s2`, … in the order they were added.

intent.description: One line on what it will hold, shown while it's pending.

rev.description: Counts the writes to its body.

to.description:
The project (`prj_…`) the team Doc is made in: one where the person
writes Docs, and not their personal one.

Shared.description:
The 409 to a [`ShareCopy`] when a team Doc was made from the Doc in that
project already.

id.description: The team Doc that is there.

replace.description:
Replace the team's edits too. Without it, a team Doc edited since is
left alone and answered [`Edited`].
